Name: Dryads of the Valley
Author: hgjj
Description:
[size=5]Dryads of the Valley[/size]

[size=4]
[size=3]This mod replace the tile sheetfruitTrees.xbn by an other where all fruit trees are plant girls.[/size][/size]
[i]
[/i]Strangely the bees in Stardew Valley seem toonly go on crops flower and wild flowers but ignore completely the flowers of fruit trees. Anyway, those bees are so lazy that they can prefer to survive on one single flower for a whole seasons than going more than five tile away from their hive. Probably that the trees flowers were just to high for them.
But whatever the reason, trees need to be pollinated to make fruit and reproduce. If the bees doesn't change they behaviors soon, they will cause the fruit trees extinction, or just you cutting them for their wood as they don't give you fruit anymore.
In this mode trees have adapted to not rely anymore on bees to transport their semen. Instead, they have made the bet that they could get humans do this job.

Climb in the tree,[color=#38761D][color=#00ff00][b][color=#38761D][color=#6aa84f]?[/color][color=#00ff00]?[/color][/color][color=#6aa84f]?[/color][/b][/color][/color], climb down the tree covered in pollen, go to the next tree.

Why anyone sane would do this? Because there are people that actually care about nature and endangered species!

Change log:

[color=#b6b6b6]02/04/2020[/color] Support lastest version of stardew valley.

[size=2]Wow version 2.0! That amazing, what does it add ? New plant girls ? Animated dryads ? Or maybe  a quest [size=3]!!!
[size=2]No, nothing of that, it's just that I use a standard convention for version where you increase the first digit when you make an change that make your thing incompatible with previous version.[/size]

This new version is a compatibility patch made by [size=3][size=2][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/1238942]YukoValis[/url]﻿ [/size][/size][/size] ( thank you ! ) to have the mode work with newer version of the game. The newest trees will have their vanilla apparence.

[/size][/size]

[/size][color=#d8d8d8]05/03/2017[/color] Add SFW version

Add a new alternative version where all tree arewearing clothes that change from a season to an other. [size=3]


[/size][color=#b6b6b6][size=2]03/12/2017[/size][/color][size=2] Add futa alternative version.[/size]

In real world, all the fruit trees present in Stardew Valley are Monoicous, which mean their flowers have both male and female organs. In other words those trees are hermaphrodites.
For the people that love [s] dick girls [/s] scientific accuracy, I added this alternative version that fix the lack of male organs on the dryads.
